855531.name: YNL190W
855531.summary: Involved in cellular response to water deprivation. Located in fungal-type cell wall. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855541.name: RHO5
855541.summary: Enables GTPase activity. Involved in apoptotic process; cellular response to oxidative stress; and positive regulation of adenylate cyclase-activating G protein-coupled receptor signaling pathway. Located in endomembrane system; fungal-type vacuole membrane; and plasma membrane. Orthologous to human RHOU (ras homolog family member U) and RHOV (ras homolog family member V). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855544.name: MRPL22
855544.summary: A structural constituent of ribosome. Predicted to be involved in translation. Located in mitochondrion. Part of mitochondrial large ribosomal subunit. Orthologous to human MRPL22 (mitochondrial ribosomal protein L22). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855552.name: PSD1
855552.summary: Enables phosphatidylserine decarboxylase activity. Involved in several processes, including glycerophospholipid biosynthetic process; lipid droplet formation; and mitochondrial electron transport, ubiquinol to cytochrome c. Located in lipid droplet and mitochondrial inner membrane. Is active in endoplasmic reticulum membrane. Used to study Parkinson's disease. Orthologous to human PISD (phosphatidylserine decarboxylase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855554.name: SKO1
855554.summary: Enables several functions, including DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific; mitogen-activated protein kinase binding activity; and transcription corepressor activity. Involved in cellular response to osmotic stress; negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II; and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Located in cytosol and nucleus. Orthologous to human ATF2 (activating transcription factor 2); ATF7 (activating transcription factor 7); and CREB5 (cAMP responsive element binding protein 5). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855580.name: MEP2
855580.summary: Enables ammonium channel activity. Involved in several processes, including ammonium transmembrane transport; nitrogen utilization; and pseudohyphal growth. Located in plasma membrane. Used to study renal tubular acidosis. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Rh deficiency syndrome; Rh isoimmunization; hemolytic anemia; and overhydrated hereditary stomatocytosis. Orthologous to several human genes including RHAG (Rh associated glycoprotein); RHCE (Rh blood group CcEe antigens); and RHD (Rh blood group D antigen). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855581.name: AAH1
855581.summary: Enables adenine deaminase activity. Involved in adenine catabolic process and hypoxanthine salvage. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in asthma; colon cancer; pleural tuberculosis; severe combined immunodeficiency (multiple); and uterine fibroid. Orthologous to human ADA (adenosine deaminase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855594.name: NRK1
855594.summary: Enables ribosylnicotinamide kinase activity. Involved in NAD+ biosynthetic process via the salvage pathway and nicotinamide riboside metabolic process. Located in fungal-type vacuole. Orthologous to several human genes including NMRK1 (nicotinamide riboside kinase 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855600.name: NMA111
855600.summary: Enables serine-type endopeptidase activity. Involved in several processes, including apoptotic process; cellular response to heat; and stress-induced homeostatically regulated protein degradation pathway. Located in nucleus. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including 3-methylglutaconic aciduria type 8; autosomal dominant cerebral arteriopathy with subcortical infarcts and leukoencephalopathy 2; gastrointestinal system cancer (multiple); macular degeneration (multiple); and neurodegenerative disease (multiple). Orthologous to several human genes including HTRA1 (HtrA serine peptidase 1); HTRA2 (HtrA serine peptidase 2); and HTRA3 (HtrA serine peptidase 3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855612.name: CYB5
855612.summary: Enables electron transfer activity. Involved in sterol biosynthetic process. Located in endoplasmic reticulum membrane. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in methemoglobinemia and methemoglobinemia and ambiguous genitalia. Orthologous to human CYB5A (cytochrome b5 type A) and CYB5B (cytochrome b5 type B). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855625.name: RAS2
855625.summary: Enables GTP binding activity and GTPase activity. Involved in several processes, including cytoplasm to vacuole targeting by the Cvt pathway; positive regulation of transcription by galactose; and protein localization to bud neck. Located in several cellular components, including endoplasmic reticulum membrane; mitochondrion; and nucleus. Used to study colorectal cancer. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Noonan syndrome 12. Orthologous to human RRAS2 (RAS related 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855626.name: PHO23
855626.summary: Enables histone H3K4me3 reader activity. Involved in several processes, including cellular response to heat; positive regulation of invasive growth in response to glucose limitation; and regulation of gene expression. Located in nucleus. Part of Rpd3L complex. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in head and neck squamous cell carcinoma and squamous cell carcinoma. Orthologous to several human genes including ING4 (inhibitor of growth family member 4). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855633.name: NST1
855633.summary: Involved in response to salt stress. Acts upstream of or within negative regulation of translation. Located in P-body. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855641.name: SAL1
855641.summary: Enables ATP:ADP antiporter activity and calcium ion binding activity. Involved in ADP transport; ATP transport; and mitochondrial transport. Located in mitochondrion. Orthologous to several human genes including SLC25A23 (solute carrier family 25 member 23). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855642.name: PMS1
855642.summary: Enables ATP binding activity and ATP hydrolysis activity. Contributes to dinucleotide insertion or deletion binding activity; heteroduplex DNA loop binding activity; and single-stranded DNA binding activity. Involved in meiotic mismatch repair. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Part of MutLalpha complex. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Lynch syndrome; hereditary nonpolyposis colorectal cancer type 4; mismatch repair cancer syndrome; ovarian cancer; and urinary bladder cancer. Orthologous to several human genes including PMS2 (PMS1 homolog 2, mismatch repair system component). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855643.name: SWS2
855643.summary: A structural constituent of ribosome. Predicted to be involved in mitochondrial translation. Located in peroxisome. Part of mitochondrial small ribosomal subunit. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855644.name: EOS1
855644.summary: Involved in cellular response to oxidative stress and protein N-linked glycosylation. Located in endoplasmic reticulum membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855645.name: TPM1
855645.summary: Enables actin lateral binding activity. Involved in actin cytoskeleton organization; cellular hyperosmotic response; and pseudohyphal growth. Located in actin filament bundle and cellular bud neck contractile ring. Is active in actin filament. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in congenital myopathy (multiple); distal arthrogryposis type 1A; and intrinsic cardiomyopathy (multiple). Orthologous to human TPM1 (tropomyosin 1); TPM2 (tropomyosin 2); and TPM3 (tropomyosin 3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855648.name: MKS1
855648.summary: Involved in several processes, including mitochondria-nucleus signaling pathway; negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II; and regulation of pseudohyphal growth. Located in cytoplasm. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855651.name: MSK1
855651.summary: Enables lysine-tRNA ligase activity. Involved in mitochondrial lysyl-tRNA aminoacylation and tRNA processing. Located in mitochondrion. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855652.name: RNH201
855652.summary: Enables RNA-DNA hybrid ribonuclease activity. Involved in DNA replication, removal of RNA primer. Acts upstream of or within R-loop processing. Located in nucleus. Part of ribonuclease H2 complex. Used to study Aicardi-Goutieres syndrome. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Aicardi-Goutieres syndrome. Orthologous to human RNASEH2A (ribonuclease H2 subunit A). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855653.name: LAT1
855653.summary: Enables dihydrolipoyllysine-residue acetyltransferase activity. Involved in pyruvate decarboxylation to acetyl-CoA. Located in mitochondrion. Part of pyruvate dehydrogenase complex. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in pyruvate decarboxylase deficiency. Orthologous to human DLAT (dihydrolipoamide S-acetyltransferase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855655.name: RPL16B
855655.summary: Enables RNA binding activity. Involved in maturation of LSU-rRNA. Part of cytosolic large ribosomal subunit. Is active in nucleolus. Orthologous to human RPL13A (ribosomal protein L13a). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855658.name: RPL9B
855658.summary: A structural constituent of ribosome. Involved in cytoplasmic translation. Part of cytosolic large ribosomal subunit. Orthologous to human RPL9 (ribosomal protein L9). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855660.name: AQR1
855660.summary: Enables monocarboxylic acid transmembrane transporter activity; threonine efflux transmembrane transporter activity; and xenobiotic transmembrane transporter activity. Involved in amino acid export across plasma membrane and monocarboxylic acid transport. Located in cell periphery and fungal-type vacuole. Is active in plasma membrane. Orthologous to human SLC75A1 (solute carrier family 75 member 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855691.name: IDH1
855691.summary: Contributes to isocitrate dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity. Involved in isocitrate metabolic process and tricarboxylic acid cycle. Located in mitochondrial nucleoid. Part of isocitrate dehydrogenase complex (NAD+). Used to study early infantile epileptic encephalopathy. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in retinitis pigmentosa 46. Orthologous to several human genes including IDH3B (isocitrate dehydrogenase (NAD(+)) 3 non-catalytic subunit beta). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855709.name: RCM1
855709.summary: Enables rRNA (cytosine-C5-)-methyltransferase activity. Involved in rRNA base methylation. Located in nucleolus. Orthologous to several human genes including NSUN5 (NOP2/Sun RNA methyltransferase 5). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855710.name: HDA1
855710.summary: Enables chromatin binding activity and identical protein binding activity. Contributes to histone deacetylase activity. Involved in negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Part of HDA1 complex. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in ataxia telangiectasia; chondrodysplasia with platyspondyly, distinctive brachydactyly, hydrocephaly, and microphthalmia; eating disorder; and retinal degeneration. Orthologous to several human genes including HDAC6 (histone deacetylase 6). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855711.name: ARK1
855711.summary: Enables protein serine/threonine kinase activity. Involved in actin filament organization and regulation of clathrin-dependent endocytosis. Located in actin cortical patch. Orthologous to human BMP2K (BMP2 inducible kinase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855716.name: PUB1
855716.summary: Enables mRNA binding activity; poly(U) RNA binding activity; and ribosome binding activity. Involved in several processes, including cellular response to glucose starvation; regulation of gene expression; and stress granule assembly. Located in P-body; cytoplasmic stress granule; and nucleus. Used to study amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis type 26. Orthologous to human TIA1 (TIA1 cytotoxic granule associated RNA binding protein) and TIAL1 (TIA1 cytotoxic granule associated RNA binding protein like 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855723.name: IDP3
855723.summary: Enables isocitrate dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity. Involved in fatty acid beta-oxidation. Located in peroxisome. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including D-2-hydroxyglutaric aciduria 2; carcinoma (multiple); hematologic cancer (multiple); high grade glioma (multiple); and lung cancer (multiple). Orthologous to several human genes including IDH1 (isocitrate dehydrogenase (NADP(+)) 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855728.name: HRB1
855728.summary: Enables chromatin binding activity and mRNA binding activity. Involved in nuclear mRNA surveillance. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Orthologous to human MYEF2 (myelin expression factor 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855732.name: CIT1
855732.summary: Enables citrate synthase activity. Involved in acetyl-CoA catabolic process; citrate metabolic process; and tricarboxylic acid cycle. Located in mitochondrion. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in dilated cardiomyopathy and hypertrophic cardiomyopathy. Orthologous to human CS (citrate synthase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855739.name: VPS27
855739.otheraliases: YNR006W, DID7, GRD11, SSV17, VPL23, VPT27
855739.summary: Enables several functions, including phosphatidylinositol-3-phosphate binding activity; polyubiquitin modification-dependent protein binding activity; and protein heterodimerization activity. Involved in several processes, including ATP export; microlipophagy; and vacuolar transport. Located in endosome and vacuolar membrane. Part of ESCRT-0 complex. Used to study Parkinson's disease. Orthologous to human HGS (hepatocyte growth factor-regulated tyrosine kinase substrate). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855764.name: ALG12
855764.summary: Enables dol-P-Man:Man(7)GlcNAc(2)-PP-Dol alpha-1,6-mannosyltransferase activity. Involved in dolichol-linked oligosaccharide biosynthetic process. Located in endoplasmic reticulum. Used to study congenital disorder of glycosylation type I. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in congenital disorder of glycosylation Ig. Orthologous to human ALG12 (ALG12 alpha-1,6-mannosyltransferase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855765.name: SSK2
855765.description: mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase kinase SSK2
855765.otherdesignations: mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase kinase SSK2
855765.nomenclaturename: mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase kinase SSK2
855765.summary: Enables MAP kinase kinase kinase activity and actin binding activity. Involved in cellular response to osmotic stress; p38MAPK cascade; and regulation of actin cytoskeleton organization. Located in several cellular components, including cellular bud neck; cellular bud tip; and incipient cellular bud site. Orthologous to human MAP3K4 (mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase kinase 4). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855786.name: LYS9
855786.summary: Enables saccharopine dehydrogenase (NADP+, L-glutamate-forming) activity. Involved in L-lysine biosynthetic process. Located in cell periphery and cytoplasm. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in hyperlysinemia. Orthologous to human AASS (aminoadipate-semialdehyde synthase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855787.name: BRE5
855787.summary: Enables identical protein binding activity. Involved in several processes, including protein retention in Golgi apparatus; regulation of vesicle-mediated transport; and ribophagy. Located in P-body; cytosol; and mitochondrion. Part of Ubp3-Bre5 deubiquitination complex. Orthologous to human G3BP1 (G3BP stress granule assembly factor 1) and G3BP2 (G3BP stress granule assembly factor 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855803.name: YNR066C
855803.summary: Predicted to enable transmembrane signaling receptor activity. Predicted to be involved in Golgi to endosome transport; Golgi to vacuole transport; and protein targeting to vacuole. Located in membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855807.name: PDR18
855807.summary: Enables ABC-type xenobiotic transporter activity. Involved in cellular response to xenobiotic stimulus and sterol homeostasis. Located in cytosol and mitochondrion. Is active in plasma membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855844.name: SSO1
855844.summary: Enables several functions, including SNAP receptor activity; phosphatidic acid binding activity; and phosphatidylinositol bisphosphate binding activity. Involved in SNARE complex assembly; ascospore-type prospore assembly; and maintenance of protein location in plasma membrane. Located in fungal-type vacuole membrane; plasma membrane; and prospore membrane. Part of SNARE complex. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease; Hirschsprung's disease; congenital diarrhea; familial hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis 4; and generalized epilepsy with febrile seizures plus 9. Orthologous to several human genes including STX1A (syntaxin 1A). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855866.name: FUM1
855866.summary: Enables fumarate hydratase activity. Involved in double-strand break repair; fumarate metabolic process; and tricarboxylic acid cycle. Located in cytosol and mitochondrial matrix. Is active in nucleus. Used to study leiomyomatosis. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in fumarase deficiency and lung non-small cell carcinoma. Orthologous to human FH (fumarate hydratase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855869.name: APM1
855869.summary: Predicted to enable clathrin-cargo adaptor activity. Involved in Golgi to vacuole transport. Part of AP-1 adaptor complex. Orthologous to several human genes including AP1M2 (adaptor related protein complex 1 subunit mu 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855871.name: USV1
855871.summary: Enables sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Involved in cellular response to salt stress and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Located in nucleus. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855874.name: ALG5
855874.summary: Enables dolichyl-phosphate beta-glucosyltransferase activity. Involved in protein N-linked glycosylation. Located in endoplasmic reticulum membrane. Used to study congenital disorder of glycosylation type I. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in polycystic kidney disease 7. Orthologous to human ALG5 (ALG5 dolichyl-phosphate beta-glucosyltransferase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855875.name: NEW1
855875.summary: Enables ribosome binding activity and translation termination factor activity. Involved in regulation of translational termination and ribosomal small subunit biogenesis. Located in cytoplasm. Orthologous to human ABCF1 (ATP binding cassette subfamily F member 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855876.name: CHP1
855876.summary: Enables several functions, including misfolded protein binding activity; nascent polypeptide-associated complex binding activity; and translation elongation factor binding activity. Involved in 'de novo' cotranslational protein folding. Located in cytoplasm. Orthologous to human PBDC1 (polysaccharide biosynthesis domain containing 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855898.name: TPK2
855898.description: cAMP-dependent protein kinase catalytic subunit TPK2
855898.otherdesignations: cAMP-dependent protein kinase catalytic subunit TPK2
855898.nomenclaturename: cAMP-dependent protein kinase catalytic subunit TPK2
855898.summary: Enables cAMP-dependent protein kinase activity. Involved in several processes, including Ras protein signal transduction; invasive growth in response to glucose limitation; and negative regulation of cytoplasmic mRNA processing body assembly. Located in several cellular components, including P-body; chromatin; and cytosol. Part of cAMP-dependent protein kinase complex. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in adrenal cortical adenoma; congestive heart failure; fibrolamellar carcinoma; platelet-type bleeding disorder 19; and primary pigmented nodular adrenocortical disease 4. Orthologous to several human genes including PRKACA (protein kinase cAMP-activated catalytic subunit alpha); PRKACB (protein kinase cAMP-activated catalytic subunit beta); and PRKACG (protein kinase cAMP-activated catalytic subunit gamma). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855918.name: RTC6
855918.summary: Enables zinc ion binding activity. Involved in ribosome biogenesis. Predicted to be located in mitochondrial inner membrane. Predicted to be part of mitochondrial large ribosomal subunit. Orthologous to human MRPL36 (mitochondrial ribosomal protein L36). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855919.name: RTT10
855919.summary: Enables enzyme regulator activity. Involved in endocytic recycling and wobble position ribose methylation. Located in endosome. Orthologous to human WDR6 (WD repeat domain 6). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855926.name: CUP9
855926.summary: Enables RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity and RNA polymerase II-specific DNA-binding transcription factor binding activity. Involved in negative regulation of dipeptide transport and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Used to study Down syndrome; cancer (multiple); restless legs syndrome; and substance dependence. Orthologous to human MEIS3P2 (Meis homeobox 3 pseudogene 2); TGIF2 (TGFB induced factor homeobox 2); and TGIF2LX (TGFB induced factor homeobox 2 like X-linked). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855929.name: NIP100
855929.summary: Predicted to enable microtubule binding activity. Involved in establishment of mitotic spindle orientation. Part of dynactin complex. Orthologous to human CLIP1 (CAP-Gly domain containing linker protein 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855930.name: MRPL40
855930.summary: A structural constituent of ribosome. Predicted to be involved in translation. Located in mitochondrion. Part of mitochondrial large ribosomal subunit. Orthologous to human MRPL24 (mitochondrial ribosomal protein L24). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855937.name: ATG29
855937.summary: Enables SNARE binding activity. Involved in autophagy of mitochondrion; cellular response to nitrogen starvation; and macroautophagy. Located in phagophore assembly site. Part of Atg1/ULK1 kinase complex. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855951.name: RRD2
855951.summary: Enables peptidyl-prolyl cis-trans isomerase activity and protein phosphatase regulator activity. Involved in mitotic spindle organization and response to osmotic stress. Part of protein phosphatase type 2A complex. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Parkinson's disease 25. Orthologous to human PTPA (protein phosphatase 2 phosphatase activator). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855953.name: YPL150W
855953.summary: Enables protein kinase activity. Involved in protein phosphorylation. Located in cytoplasmic ribonucleoprotein granule. Orthologous to human MELK (maternal embryonic leucine zipper kinase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855954.name: ATG5
855954.summary: Enables cargo receptor ligand activity and enzyme activator activity. Contributes to Atg8-family ligase activity. Involved in cellular response to potassium ion starvation; cytoplasm to vacuole targeting by the Cvt pathway; and macroautophagy. Located in several cellular components, including autophagosome; phagophore; and vacuole-isolation membrane contact site. Part of Atg12-Atg5-Atg16 complex. Used to study autosomal recessive spinocerebellar ataxia 25. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal recessive spinocerebellar ataxia 25. Orthologous to human ATG5 (autophagy related 5). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855965.name: SPP1
855965.summary: Enables chromatin binding activity and histone H3K4me3 reader activity. Contributes to histone H3K4 methyltransferase activity. Involved in regulation of DNA-templated transcription; regulation of meiotic DNA double-strand break formation; and subtelomeric heterochromatin formation. Located in cytosol and nucleus. Part of Set1C/COMPASS complex. Orthologous to human CXXC1 (CXXC finger protein 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855971.name: COX11
855971.summary: Enables cuprous ion binding activity. Involved in aerobic respiration; cell redox homeostasis; and mitochondrial respiratory chain complex IV assembly. Located in mitochondrial inner membrane; mitochondrial intermembrane space; and mitochondrial ribosome. Is active in mitochondrion. Used to study mitochondrial complex IV deficiency nuclear type 23 and mitochondrial encephalomyopathy. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in mitochondrial complex IV deficiency nuclear type 23. Orthologous to human COX11 (cytochrome c oxidase copper chaperone COX11). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855974.name: TAF14
855974.summary: Enables DNA binding activity and RNA polymerase II general transcription initiation factor activity. Involved in RNA polymerase II preinitiation complex assembly; chromatin remodeling; and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Located in nucleus. Part of RNA polymerase II, holoenzyme; chromatin; and mediator complex. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in familial adult myoclonic epilepsy 4. Orthologous to human MLLT1 (MLLT1 super elongation complex subunit); MLLT3 (MLLT3 super elongation complex subunit); and YEATS2 (YEATS domain containing 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855983.name: VPS30
855983.summary: Predicted to enable phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase binding activity and protein-macromolecule adaptor activity. Involved in several processes, including cellular response to potassium ion starvation; macroautophagy; and vacuolar transport. Located in cytoplasm and vacuole-isolation membrane contact site. Part of phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase complex, class III, type I and phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase complex, class III, type II. Colocalizes with phagophore assembly site. Used to study breast cancer. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Machado-Joseph disease. Orthologous to human BECN1 (beclin 1) and BECN2 (beclin 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855984.name: DBP1
855984.description: putative DEAD-box ATP-dependent RNA helicase DBP1
855984.otherdesignations: putative DEAD-box ATP-dependent RNA helicase DBP1
855984.nomenclaturename: putative DEAD-box ATP-dependent RNA helicase DBP1
855984.summary: Enables several functions, including ATP hydrolysis activity; DNA/RNA helicase activity; and G-quadruplex DNA binding activity. Involved in positive regulation of formation of translation preinitiation complex and translational initiation. Located in cytoplasm. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in colorectal cancer and syndromic X-linked intellectual disability. Orthologous to several human genes including DDX3X (DEAD-box helicase 3 X-linked) and DDX3Y (DEAD-box helicase 3 Y-linked). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855985.name: MRP51
855985.summary: A structural constituent of ribosome. Involved in mitochondrial translational initiation. Located in mitochondrion. Part of mitochondrial small ribosomal subunit. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855991.name: PEX25
855991.summary: Involved in peroxisome fission; protein import into peroxisome matrix; and regulation of peroxisome size. Located in peroxisomal membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855999.name: SYH1
855999.summary: Predicted to enable mRNA regulatory element binding translation repressor activity. Involved in nuclear pore localization. Located in cytoplasm. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Parkinson's disease. Orthologous to human GIGYF1 (GRB10 interacting GYF protein 1) and GIGYF2 (GRB10 interacting GYF protein 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856002.name: ELP4
856002.summary: Enables identical protein binding activity. Contributes to ATP hydrolysis activity and tRNA binding activity. Involved in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and tRNA wobble uridine modification. Located in cytoplasm. Part of elongator holoenzyme complex. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in aniridia. Orthologous to human ELP4 (elongator acetyltransferase complex subunit 4). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856004.name: ATG21
856004.summary: Enables phosphatidylinositol-3,5-bisphosphate binding activity; phosphatidylinositol-3-phosphate binding activity; and phosphatidylinositol-4-phosphate binding activity. Involved in several processes, including autophagy of mitochondrion; cytoplasm to vacuole targeting by the Cvt pathway; and macroautophagy. Located in several cellular components, including endosome; fungal-type vacuole membrane; and phagophore assembly site. Orthologous to human WIPI1 (WD repeat domain, phosphoinositide interacting 1) and WIPI2 (WD repeat domain, phosphoinositide interacting 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

856015.name: RPS6A
856015.summary: A structural constituent of ribosome. Involved in maturation of SSU-rRNA from tricistronic rRNA transcript (SSU-rRNA, 5.8S rRNA, LSU-rRNA). Part of cytosolic small ribosomal subunit and small-subunit processome. Orthologous to human RPS6 (ribosomal protein S6). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

856016.name: RLM1
856016.summary: Enables DNA binding activity; DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific; and mitogen-activated protein kinase binding activity. Involved in several processes, including cellular response to heat; regulation of G1 to G0 transition; and regulation of flocculation. Located in nucleus. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in dilated cardiomyopathy and neurodevelopmental disorder with hypotonia, stereotypic hand movements, and impaired language. Orthologous to several human genes including BORCS8-MEF2B (BORCS8-MEF2B readthrough); MEF2A (myocyte enhancer factor 2A); and MEF2B (myocyte enhancer factor 2B). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856018.name: YDC1
856018.summary: Enables N-acylsphingosine amidohydrolase activity. Involved in ceramide biosynthetic process and ceramide catabolic process. Located in endoplasmic reticulum. Used to study leukodystrophy. Orthologous to human ACER3 (alkaline ceramidase 3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

856019.name: ELP3
856019.summary: Predicted to enable tRNA uridine(34) acetyltransferase activity. Involved in tRNA wobble base 5-methoxycarbonylmethyl-2-thiouridinylation. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Part of elongator holoenzyme complex. Orthologous to human ELP3 (elongator acetyltransferase complex subunit 3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856026.name: RPL21B
856026.summary: Predicted to be a structural constituent of ribosome. Predicted to be involved in cytoplasmic translation. Part of cytosolic large ribosomal subunit. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in hypotrichosis 12. Orthologous to human RPL21 (ribosomal protein L21). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856027.name: ATP4
856027.summary: Contributes to proton-transporting ATP synthase activity, rotational mechanism and proton-transporting ATPase activity, rotational mechanism. Involved in protein-containing complex assembly and proton motive force-driven ATP synthesis. Located in mitochondrial inner membrane. Part of proton-transporting ATP synthase complex. Is active in mitochondrion. Orthologous to human ATP5PB (ATP synthase peripheral stalk-membrane subunit b). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856044.name: ALD6
856044.summary: Enables aldehyde dehydrogenase [NAD(P)+] activity. Involved in NADPH regeneration; acetate biosynthetic process; and response to salt stress. Located in cytosol and mitochondrion. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including alcohol dependence; alcohol use disorder; artery disease (multiple); diabetes mellitus (multiple); and liver disease (multiple). Orthologous to several human genes including ALDH1A1 (aldehyde dehydrogenase 1 family member A1); ALDH1A2 (aldehyde dehydrogenase 1 family member A2); and ALDH1A3 (aldehyde dehydrogenase 1 family member A3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

856050.name: SUR1
856050.description: mannosylinositol phosphorylceramide synthase catalytic subunit SUR1
856050.otherdesignations: mannosylinositol phosphorylceramide synthase catalytic subunit SUR1
856050.nomenclaturename: mannosylinositol phosphorylceramide synthase catalytic subunit SUR1
856050.summary: Enables inositol phosphorylceramide mannosyltransferase activity. Involved in glycosphingolipid biosynthetic process; mannosyl diphosphorylinositol ceramide metabolic process; and mannosyl-inositol phosphorylceramide metabolic process. Located in fungal-type vacuole membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856051.name: LCL1
856051.summary: Predicted to be located in plasma membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856060.name: SGF11
856060.description: SAGA histone acetyltransferase complex subunit SGF11
856060.otherdesignations: SAGA histone acetyltransferase complex subunit SGF11
856060.nomenclaturename: SAGA histone acetyltransferase complex subunit SGF11
856060.summary: Enables enzyme activator activity. Involved in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Located in nucleus. Part of DUBm complex and SAGA complex. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

856065.name: SSN3
856065.otheraliases: YPL042C, CDK8, GIG2, NUT7, RYE5, SRB10, SSX7, UME5, URR1
856065.summary: Enables RNA polymerase II CTD heptapeptide repeat kinase activity and cyclin-dependent protein serine/threonine kinase activity. Involved in negative regulation of filamentous growth; protein destabilization; and regulation of gene expression. Part of mediator complex. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in developmental and epileptic encephalopathy 87 and dilated cardiomyopathy. Orthologous to human CDK19 (cyclin dependent kinase 19) and CDK8 (cyclin dependent kinase 8). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856067.name: ISM1
856067.summary: Predicted to enable isoleucine-tRNA ligase activity. Involved in mitochondrial translation. Located in mitochondrion. Used to study mitochondrial metabolism disease. Orthologous to human IARS2 (isoleucyl-tRNA synthetase 2, mitochondrial). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

856070.name: EGD1
856070.summary: Enables unfolded protein binding activity. Involved in cotranslational protein targeting to membrane and macroautophagy. Acts upstream of or within mitophagy. Located in cytoplasm. Part of nascent polypeptide-associated complex. Orthologous to human BTF3 (basic transcription factor 3) and BTF3L4 (basic transcription factor 3 like 4). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856076.name: PHO85
856076.summary: Enables cyclin-dependent protein serine/threonine kinase activity. Involved in several processes, including G1/S transition of mitotic cell cycle; regulation of macroautophagy; and regulation of phosphorus metabolic process. Located in cellular bud neck and nucleus. Part of Pho85-Pho80 CDK-cyclin complex. Used to study lissencephaly and lissencephaly 7 with cerebellar hypoplasia. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Alzheimer's disease and lissencephaly 7 with cerebellar hypoplasia. Orthologous to several human genes including CDK5 (cyclin dependent kinase 5). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856077.name: TRM44
856077.summary: Enables tRNA(Ser) (uridine(44)-2'-O-ribose)-methyltransferase activity. Involved in tRNA nucleoside ribose methylation. Located in cytoplasm. Orthologous to human TRMT44 (tRNA methyltransferase 44 homolog). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856078.name: SUV3
856078.summary: Enables RNA helicase activity. Contributes to exoribonuclease II activity. Involved in Group I intron splicing; mitochondrial DNA replication; and mitochondrial RNA catabolic process. Located in mitochondrion. Part of mitochondrial degradosome. Orthologous to human SUPV3L1 (Suv3 like RNA helicase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

856092.name: HST2
856092.summary: Enables histone H4K16 deacetylase activity, NAD-dependent. Involved in negative regulation of mitotic recombination and rDNA heterochromatin formation. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Orthologous to several human genes including SIRT2 (sirtuin 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856094.name: MRPS16
856094.summary: A structural constituent of ribosome. Predicted to be involved in mitochondrial translation. Located in mitochondrion. Part of mitochondrial small ribosomal subunit. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in combined oxidative phosphorylation deficiency 2. Orthologous to human MRPS16 (mitochondrial ribosomal protein S16). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856098.name: RQC2
856098.summary: Enables alpha-aminoacyl-tRNA binding activity; ribosomal large subunit binding activity; and tRNA binding activity. Involved in CAT tailing and peptide biosynthetic process. Located in cytoplasmic stress granule. Part of RQC complex. Is active in cytosolic ribosome. Used to study neuromuscular disease. Orthologous to human NEMF (nuclear export mediator factor). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856099.name: CHL1
856099.summary: Enables DNA helicase activity. Involved in establishment of sister chromatid cohesion; interstrand cross-link repair; and mitotic sister chromatid cohesion. Acts upstream of or within mitotic G1 DNA damage checkpoint signaling. Located in chromatin and replication fork. Used to study Warsaw breakage syndrome. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Warsaw breakage syndrome. Orthologous to several human genes including DDX11 (DEAD/H-box helicase 11). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856101.name: NCR1
856101.summary: Enables sterol binding activity. Involved in sphingolipid metabolic process and sterol transport. Located in fungal-type vacuole membrane. Used to study Niemann-Pick disease and Niemann-Pick disease type C1. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Niemann-Pick disease type C1. Orthologous to several human genes including NPC1 (NPC intracellular cholesterol transporter 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856106.name: HAT1
856106.summary: Enables chromatin binding activity and histone acetyltransferase activity. Involved in double-strand break repair and subtelomeric heterochromatin formation. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Part of histone acetyltransferase complex. Orthologous to human HAT1 (histone acetyltransferase 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

856115.name: REC8
856115.summary: Enables chromatin binding activity. Involved in meiosis I cell cycle process; meiotic sister chromatid cohesion; and protein localization to chromosome, centromeric region. Located in condensed chromosome, centromeric region and condensed nuclear chromosome. Is active in chromosome, centromeric region. Orthologous to human REC8 (REC8 meiotic recombination protein). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

856121.name: MRX21
856121.summary: Enables 3'-phosphoadenosine 5'-phosphosulfate transmembrane transporter activity and 5'-adenylyl sulfate transmembrane transporter activity. Involved in 3'-phospho-5'-adenylyl sulfate transmembrane transport and 5'-adenylyl sulfate transmembrane transport. Located in mitochondrion. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

856132.name: AGC1
856132.summary: Enables transmembrane transporter activity. Involved in L-glutamate transmembrane transport and aspartate transmembrane transport. Located in vacuole-mitochondrion membrane contact site. Used to study citrullinemia; common bile duct disease; and intrahepatic cholestasis. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Asperger syndrome; adult-onset type II citrullinemia; autistic disorder; developmental and epileptic encephalopathy 39; and neonatal-onset type II citrullinemia. Orthologous to several human genes including SLC25A12 (solute carrier family 25 member 12) and SLC25A13 (solute carrier family 25 member 13). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856135.name: YME1
856135.summary: Enables ATP-dependent peptidase activity. Involved in several processes, including membrane protein proteolysis; mitochondrial protein quality control; and protein localization to mitochondrion. Located in mitochondrion. Part of i-AAA complex. Is active in mitochondrial inner membrane. Used to study colorectal adenocarcinoma and mitochondrial metabolism disease. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in optic atrophy 11. Orthologous to human YME1L1 (YME1 like 1 ATPase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856137.name: ATH1
856137.summary: Enables alpha,alpha-trehalase activity. Involved in carbon utilization; trehalose catabolic process; and trehalose transport. Located in several cellular components, including cell wall-bounded periplasmic space; fungal-type cell wall; and fungal-type vacuole lumen. Orthologous to human PGGHG (protein-glucosylgalactosylhydroxylysine glucosidase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856142.name: CSR2
856142.summary: Enables ubiquitin protein ligase binding activity. Involved in fungal-type cell wall organization and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Located in nucleus. Orthologous to several human genes including ARRDC1 (arrestin domain containing 1); ARRDC2 (arrestin domain containing 2); and ARRDC3 (arrestin domain containing 3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

856152.name: ERV2
856152.summary: Enables flavin-dependent sulfhydryl oxidase activity. Involved in regulation of protein folding in endoplasmic reticulum. Located in fungal-type vacuole membrane. Is active in endoplasmic reticulum membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

856156.name: RPL43A
856156.summary: Predicted to be a structural constituent of ribosome. Predicted to be involved in cytoplasmic translation. Part of cytosolic large ribosomal subunit. Orthologous to human RPL37A (ribosomal protein L37a) and RPL37AP8 (ribosomal protein L37a pseudogene 8). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856163.name: MAK3
856163.summary: Enables protein-N-terminal amino-acid acetyltransferase activity. Involved in N-terminal protein amino acid acetylation and regulation of protein localization. Part of NatC complex. Orthologous to human NAA30 (N-alpha-acetyltransferase 30, NatC catalytic subunit). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

856173.name: ARO7
856173.summary: Enables L-tyrosine binding activity; chorismate mutase activity; and tryptophan binding activity. Involved in L-phenylalanine biosynthetic process; L-tyrosine biosynthetic process; and chorismate metabolic process. Located in nucleus. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856174.name: JID1
856174.summary: Located in mitochondrial inner membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]
